extracted.stage: Estate administration; property awaiting sale, IHT due
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of an illiquid St Albans estate valued at about £387,500 enquires about borrowing £46,000 for professional fees and inheritance tax ahead of an HMRC deadline of 16 November 2026.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of the executors; we have logged the details you provided. To take this further we will need confirmation of the executors' identities and grant status, a breakdown of the estate's assets and liabilities (including the property valuation and any charges), the IHT computation or HMRC correspondence showing the amount due, and a breakdown of the £46,000 sought. Please also confirm your firm's engagement with the executors and contact details for the person handling the sale. We will review once these are received and come back to you with any further questions.
